resources.string: Add local music to listen offline whenever you like.

Add the system media library, one audio file or a music folder from Library. Referencing a file keeps the original in place; importing creates a watch copy only when selected. Local playback, favorites and playlists work independently offline.

Grant access only to the files or folders you select. Access to one audio file does not include nearby lyrics. Select the source again when access expires. Cancelled scans and temporarily unavailable sources preserve the library. Library explains available options when the device has no file picker.

The media service continues playback when you leave a page or turn off the screen. Headphone disconnection or an unsafe output pauses playback. Changing backend saves the position and releases the previous player, then restores paused. Check system app and media permissions if the device restricts background playback.

Common types include MP3, AAC, M4A, FLAC, WAV and Ogg; encoding and output depend on the device and backend. The Media3 path provides APE 3990 Fast/Normal PCM16 and uncompressed DSF/DFF DSD64 converted to PCM16/88200. Other combinations such as high compression APE and DST report unsupported. Conversion preserves the original audio.

Removing an index entry, removing a playlist member and deleting an original file are separate actions. Deletion, renaming, moving and tag writes each preview their effects for confirmation. Segments sharing a whole track appear together. Moving across sources verifies the copy before source deletion is confirmed. Cache cleanup preserves music, favorites and playlists.

Choose music, images and fonts you have permission to use. Read licenses before importing themes or fonts; phone transfers require separate license and pairing permissions. The MeloX Watch license does not cover your audio, images, fonts or account data.

Your library, favorites, playlists, settings and local connection data stay on the device. The app does not upload local IP addresses, device connection information, file paths or the whole library. Error records contain only an area, code and minute timestamp; view, clear or explicitly export them to a local folder.

Login and online playback send the requests needed for the selected music service. Lyrics or artwork lookup and update checks start when you request them. Meting is off by default and uses your configured service. Account and service credentials are stored separately on the device. Requests can be cancelled when leaving their flow.

Wi-Fi transfers receive files or library edits after you enable a session and confirm pairing permissions. Only permitted data is provided to an authorized peer. Closing the session releases the listener; disconnecting preserves local music and playback. Pairing secrets and local addresses are excluded from backups and error exports.

Backups export only the selected scopes and exclude audio by default, accounts, pairing keys and system access grants. An unencrypted file can be read by anyone holding it; store it in your chosen local location. Restore previews its effects and external audio still requires separate access. Ensure you have permission to use and transfer the media.
